cards.ex: She has a keen sense of smell; she can identify spices just by inhaling.
cards.exUz: Uning hid bilish sezgisi juda o'tkir; u ziravorlarni faqat hidlab aniqlay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sezishda juda yaxshi qobiliyat yoki iste'dodga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The garden was filled with the delicate scent of roses.
cards.exUz: Bog' atirlarning nozik hidi bilan to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Yengil va yoqimli hid, kuchli emas.

cards.ex: There's a fine distinction between genuine interest and polite curiosity.
cards.exUz: Chinakam qiziqish va odob yuzasidan qiziqish o'rtasida nozik farq bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik va qiyin seziladigan farq.

cards.ex: His grating voice made it difficult to listen to his presentation.
cards.exUz: Uning yoqimsiz ovozi tufayli uning taqdimotini tinglash qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Eshitish uchun yoqimsiz va bezovta qiladigan ovoz.

cards.ex: I smell something burning – is the oven on?
cards.exUz: Nimadir yonayotgan hid kelyapti – pech yoqilganmi?
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yonayotganligini sezish.

cards.ex: The wine left a lingering aftertaste of berries and chocolate.
cards.exUz: Sharob rezavorlar va shokoladning uzoq muddatli ta'mini qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatdan keyin og'izda qoladigan ta'm, uzoq vaqt davomida saqlanib qoladi.

cards.ex: The cream had a velvety texture that melted in my mouth.
cards.exUz: Krem og'zimda erib ketadigan baxmal tuzilishga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Baxmalga o'xshash, yumshoq va silliq yuzaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He has a refined palate and only drinks the finest wines.
cards.exUz: Uning ta'm bilish qobiliyati yuqori va faqat eng yaxshi vinolarni ichadi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'm bilishda yuqori darajadagi didga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The heady aroma of spices filled the market.
cards.exUz: Bozor ziravorlarning mast qiluvchi hidi bilan to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va yoqimli hid, boshni aylantiradigan.

cards.ex: Pottery is a tactile experience; you really connect with the clay.
cards.exUz: Kulolchilik - bu sezgir tajriba; siz loy bilan haqiqatan ham aloqa qilasiz.
cards.uzDef: Tezish orqali olinadigan tajriba.

cards.ex: I lost my bearings in the unfamiliar city.
cards.exUz: Men notanish shaharda yo'nalishni yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Qayerdaligini yoki qaysi tomonga ketayotganini bilmaslik.

cards.ex: Maintaining a delicate balance between work and family life is difficult.
cards.exUz: Ish va oilaviy hayot o'rtasida nozik muvozanatni saqlash qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Oson buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan muvozanat.

cards.ex: It was a gut-wrenching feeling to watch her leave.
cards.exUz: Uning ketishini ko'rish juda og'riqli his edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xafa qiladigan va qiyin his.

cards.ex: I felt a prickly sensation on my skin after using the new soap.
cards.exUz: Yangi sovunni ishlatganimdan so'ng terimda sanchuvchi tuyg'uni his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina og'riqli yoki noqulay tuyg'u.

cards.ex: The sauce had a subtle flavor of lemon and herbs.
cards.exUz: Sous limon va o'tlarning nozik ta'miga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsiz va qiyin seziladigan ta'm.

cards.ex: The loud music was a jarring experience after the quiet countryside.
cards.exUz: Qishloqning sokinligidan keyin baland musiqa hayratlanarli tajriba edi.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay va kutilmagan tajriba.

cards.ex: She has a knack for languages; she picks them up quickly.
cards.exUz: Uning tillarga qobiliyati bor; u ularni tezda o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani osonlikcha o'rganish va bajarish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The city street was a cacophony of sounds: car horns, sirens, and shouting.
cards.exUz: Shahar ko'chasi ovozlar g'alayoni edi: mashina signallari, sirenlar va qichqiriqlar.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz va tartibsiz ovozlar to'plami.

cards.ex: The darkness in the cave was a disorienting experience.
cards.exUz: G'ordagi qorong'ilik yo'nalishni yo'qotishga olib keladigan tajriba edi.
cards.uzDef: Qayerdaligini bilish qobiliyatini yo'qotishga olib keladigan tajriba.

cards.ex: The party was a heady mix of music, dancing, and laughter.
cards.exUz: Kechada musiqa, raqs va kulgining mast qiluvchi aralashmasi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli ta'sirga ega bo'lgan narsalar aralashmasi.

cards.ex: I can only give you a rough estimate of the cost.
cards.exUz: Men sizga xarajatning faqat taxminiy hisobini bera olaman.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlikni ko'zda tutmagan, taxminiy hisob.

cards.ex: The dish was a symphony of flavors: sweet, sour, and spicy.
cards.exUz: Bu taom ta'mlar simfoniyasi edi: shirin, nordon va achchiq.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda yaxshi ishlaydigan ko'plab turli ta'mlar.

cards.ex: He has a real feel for music; he can play any instrument.
cards.exUz: Uning musiqaga haqiqiy tuyg'usi bor; u har qanday asbobda o'ynay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki qilish uchun tabiiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The movie left a lingering impression on me.
cards.exUz: Film menda uzoqlashmaydigan taassurot qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida esda qoladigan taassurot.

cards.ex: There's a sharp contrast between her early and later work.
cards.exUz: Uning erta va keyingi ishlari o'rtasida keskin farq bor.
cards.uzDef: Ikkita narsa o'rtasida juda katta farq.

cards.ex: After surgery, he was put on a bland diet.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan so'ng unga ta'msiz ovqat buyurildi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mi kam yoki yo'q bo'lgan ovqat.

cards.ex: Dogs have an acute sense of hearing.
cards.exUz: Itlarning eshitish qobiliyati o'tkir.
cards.uzDef: Juda rivojlangan va sezgir sezgi.

cards.ex: They decided to take the plunge and start their own business.
cards.exUz: Ular tavakkal qilib, o'z bizneslarini boshlashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli bo'lishiga qaramay, biror ishni qilishga qaror qilish.

cards.ex: Music can be a soothing balm for the soul.
cards.exUz: Musiqa ruh uchun tinchlantiruvchi malham bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Og'riqni yoki tirnash xususiyatini kamaytirish uchun ishlatiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The grating noise of the construction work woke me up.
cards.exUz: Qurilish ishlarining g'alati shovqini meni uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yoqimsiz va bezovta qiladigan shovqin.
